label: E004AN DeviceMFT host metadata watcher
args: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $end=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(30); $seen=@{}; Write-Output ('E004AN_WATCH3_BEGIN '+(Get-Date -Format o)); while((Get-Date)-lt $end){ foreach($p in Get-Process){ try { foreach($m in $p.Modules){ if($m.ModuleName -ieq 'QcDeviceMFT8380.dll'){ $k=$p.Id.ToString()+'|'+$m.BaseAddress.ToInt64().ToString('x'); if(-not $seen.ContainsKey($k)){ $seen[$k]=1; $c=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$p.Id); $sv=Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object ProcessId -eq $p.Id; Write-Output ('E004AN_DMFT_LOAD time={0} pid={1} proc={2} base=0x{3:x} module={4}' -f (Get-Date -Format o),$p.Id,$p.ProcessName,$m.BaseAddress.ToInt64(),$m.FileName); Write-Output ('E004AN_HOST_META pid={0} ppid={1} session={2} cmd={3} exe={4}' -f $p.Id,$c.ParentProcessId,$p.SessionId,$c.CommandLine,$c.ExecutablePath); foreach($s in $sv){ Write-Output ('E004AN_HOST_SERVICE pid={0} name={1} display={2} state={3} path={4}' -f $p.Id,$s.Name,$s.DisplayName,$s.State,$s.PathName) } } } } } catch{} }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 75 }; Write-Output ('E004AN_WATCH3_END '+(Get-Date -Format o))
